export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec119/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B - <<'PY' | python3 -c 'import pathlib,sys; pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec119/fx/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json").write_text(sys.stdin.read(), encoding="utf-8")'
import json,hashlib,os,re,subprocess
R='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec119/fx'
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(R,p),'rb').read()).hexdigest()
rc=json.load(open(R+'/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json'))
man=json.load(open(R+'/plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json'))
comp=open(R+'/plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml').read()
rng=re.search(r'system-spec-harness:\n\s+version: "([^"]+)"',comp).group(1)
v=tuple(map(int,man['version'].split('.')))
in_range = (0,1,22)<=v<(1,0,0)
ep=json.load(open(R+'/plugins/system-spec-harness/references/package-contract.json'))['entry_points']['skills']
req=['run-system-spec-elicit','run-system-spec-doc-fetch','run-system-spec-compile','assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator']
eps={s:{'declared':s in ep,'skill_md_exists':os.path.isfile(f'{R}/plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{s}/SKILL.md')} for s in req}
lin=subprocess.run(['python3','-B',R+'/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-source-lineage.py','--repo-root',R],capture_output=True,text=True)
sd=rc['content_roots']['system_spec']
inputs={}
for p in [sd+'/spec-state.json',sd+'/fetched-references.json',R+'/.dev-graph/state/graph.json']+[sd+'/'+f for f in sorted(os.listdir(sd)) if f.endswith('.md')]+[sd+'/retrieval-evidence/'+f for f in sorted(os.listdir(sd+'/retrieval-evidence'))]:
    inputs[os.path.relpath(p,R)]=sha(p)
rep={'report':'run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight','skill':'run-dev-graph-system-spec','c24_receipt':{'path':'eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json','sha256':sha('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json'),'repo_root_matches_repository':rc['repo_root']==os.path.realpath(rc['content_roots']['repository']),'repository_id':rc['repository_id'],'git_common_dir':rc['git_common_dir'],'content_root':sd,'content_root_inside_repo':os.path.realpath(sd).startswith(rc['repo_root']+'/')},
 'R0_lineage_gate':{'exit':lin.returncode,'result':json.loads(lin.stdout),'decision':'new_creation' if json.loads(lin.stdout)['checked']==0 else 'resume'},
 'R1_dependency':{'plugin':man['name'],'version':man['version'],'composition_range':rng,'in_range':in_range,'entry_points':eps,'all_entry_points_ok':all(x['declared'] and x['skill_md_exists'] for x in eps.values())},
 'inputs_sha256':inputs}
rep['verdict']='PASS' if (rep['c24_receipt']['repo_root_matches_repository'] and rep['c24_receipt']['content_root_inside_repo'] and lin.returncode==0 and in_range and rep['R1_dependency']['all_entry_points_ok']) else 'FAIL'
print(json.dumps(rep,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec119/fx/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json'));print('parse ok',d['verdict'],d['R1_dependency']['version'],d['R1_dependency']['composition_range'])"
